testcase.name: Given a group containing self and others, when I getMembers, then I expect all members including self
Given an empty group, when I getSelectionLimit, then I expect SELECTION_LIMIT
Given a group only containing self, when I getSelectionLimit, then I expect SELECTION_LIMIT minus 1
Given an empty group, when I getRemainingCapacity, then I expect maximum capacity
Given a group only containing self, when I getSelectionWarning, then I expect SELECTION_WARNING minus 1
Given a group containing self and others, when I getMembersWithoutSelf, then I expect all members without self
Given an empty group, when I getSelectionWarning, then I expect SELECTION_WARNING
